notes: S2/F57/F66 (§12.2 1a, decided by principle as X.690 in full for the universal types it names): the receipt gains one unregistered unsigned attribute (an open type, judged by its framing and the universal rules of 1a only); the value is 0a 02 00 01: an ENUMERATED with a redundant leading zero octet; ENUMERATED is encoded as an INTEGER (X.690 §8.4), so the INTEGER rule applies. The receipt is otherwise fully re-signed with the test TSA key.
